args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) for money rounding

src/money.py claimed to implement banker's rounding per FIN-212 but
actually used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so values like
2.665 round to 2.66 instead of 2.67, matching tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was actually using ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

**Fix:** Switch the quantize rounding mode in `src/money.py` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

**Example:** `2.665` now rounds to `2.66` (previously `2.67` with half-up), matching the test expectations.

**CI:** Run `ci-0001` on `a22324dfa1` passed.
